newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish mobile phone firms in interconnection deal.
newsitem.headline: Polish mobile phone firms in interconnection deal.

text.p: The consortium of Polish and foreign firms operating digital mobile telephone network Era GSM has signed an interconnection deal on cooperation with analogue operator Centertel SA, Rzeczpospolita daily said.
The agreement would enable the clients of Era GSM, one of the country's two digital cellular telephone operators, to connect with Centertel telephones' users.

Era's shoreholders include Polish conglomerate Elektrim, which controls 32.5 percent of shares, US West of the United States and Deutsche Telekom's subsidiary DeTeMobil, with 22.5-percent stakes each.
Centertel is a joint venture of state-owned Telekomunikacja Polska SA (TPSA) telephone operator, French state telecom firm France Telecom and Ameritech.
